- generic: A woman in a worn shawl keeps turning toward the river. One hand worries the edge of her sleeve; her eyes search every face on the landing.
- generic: “My boy Wren hasn’t come home. I keep thinking the next boat might bring word of him.” She gathers herself. “You’re new to Ashmere, aren’t you?”
- generic: You agree to look around Village Green for a sign of Wren.
- generic: Journal updated
- generic: Elspeth watches the folded drawing in your hand.
- generic: “That could be Wren's drawing,” Elspeth says. “He was always exploring. The reeds south of the landing may be worth searching, but I can't know where he went.” “Look closely at the tracks on Reed Bank,” Elspeth says. “Follow them south. Wren is still missing.”
- generic: Journal updated
